blurb: Icarus Jet offers private jet charter services and jet card programs that provide access to a fleet of private aircraft with fixed pricing and flexible scheduling. Guests can charter various types of jets depending on their travel needs, including turboprops, light jets, midsize, super-midsize, ultra-long-range, and heavy jets. The company also assists with permits and trip support for private jet operations, including in Saudi Arabia.
extraNote: Jet card programs offer 24/7/365 customer support · Permit requirements and processing times vary by country, e.g. Saudi Arabia requires 24 hours for overflight permits and 48-72 hours for landing permits
